# PyAutoEyes — visualization dashboard

<!-- Generated by `bin/pyauto-eyes board` from registry.yaml and each instance's tracked manifest. Do not edit by hand. -->

The cross-project view of the organism's figures. Each `<lib>_visualization` project repo makes, stores and tracks its figures. This page reads each repo's tracked manifest and links to the PNGs where they live: it copies nothing, renders nothing and judges nothing.
Thumbnails and one-tap copy: [https://pyautolabs.github.io/PyAutoEyes/](https://pyautolabs.github.io/PyAutoEyes/).

To suggest an improvement to a figure, use its **suggest** link: it opens a pre-filled issue on the project repo (label `eyes-critique`). Or copy its `Use the eyes skill. review` line into an AI assistant session. The dashboard files nothing itself, and accepted critiques route through PyAutoMind intake to start_dev.
